visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man with short dark hair, wearing a light beige T-shirt, sits in an indoor studio-like setting. He is positioned in the center, speaking with a thoughtful expression while holding a large, white, spherical plush pillow in his lap. Behind him is a wall with a hexagonal textured pattern and a wooden shelf displaying a small sign that reads 'DON'T JUST DREAM IT, DO IT.' (2) The shot shifts to a medium view of the same man, revealing a professional black microphone on a boom arm in front of him. He gesticulates with his right hand as he speaks, maintaining eye contact with someone off-camera. On the table before him, a black water bottle and other small items are partially visible. (3) The scene cuts to a second Asian man with a slightly broader build, wearing a dark navy T-shirt. He is seated in a different room with a large, warm-toned abstract painting on the wall behind him. He holds a black tablet featuring an 'Insta360' logo and speaks with active hand gestures, his face illuminated by soft, even lighting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: DON'T JUST DREAM IT DO IT. [Subtitle]: 做自己其實很難. (2) [Subtitle]: 然後我們希望這件事情大家可以更有勇氣的去做! (3) [Subtitle]: 因為人生只有一次 啊你不做自己那你要做誰? (4) [Subtitle]: 像我們常常說我們是一個跳脫舒適圈的社群. (5) [Subtitle]: 那這跳脫舒適圈的大家在跳的過程中其實就是在勇敢的做自己. (6) [Subtitle]: 我覺得做自己這三個字跟 Be you 這兩個字. (7) [Subtitle]: 就是很包含在我們要表達的精神裡面. (8) [Subtitle]: 對於現代人想要有辦法勇敢做自己其實很困難. (9) [Subtitle]: 因為有很多外在的聲音外在的因素跟壓力等等. (10) [Subtitle]: 包括我自己就是沒有辦法完完全全做自己. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以能夠勇敢做自己的話才有辦法真正的開心過一輩子. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以我覺得這次周邊的理念非常棒. (13) [Subtitle]: 可能大家穿著我們 T-shirt 帶著我們帽子提醒大家說. (14) [Subtitle]: 記得要做自己.
